 "command": "mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-8979901b.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    """Rotate the source 180 degrees, then reflect it into a 3-by-2 tiling."""
    base = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    out = []
    for vertical_reflected in (False, True, False):
        rows = base[::-1] if vertical_reflected else base
        for row in rows:
            out.append(row + row[::-1])
    return out
PY
